packing: Generated source is preserved byte-for-byte; source pixels are repeated without resampling into a 2048x2048 atlas. The material samples a mortar-bounded region within the original pixels.
surface_maps: OpenGL normal, roughness and AO data baked from the generated image mortar/clay mask; all maps share its exact pixel dimensions and UVs.
world_scale: Brick scale measured from the generated mortar spacing, applied before repeating an interior mortar-bounded region on the existing 64-inch mesh UVs.
scope: Lowtide plain, sooty, glazed and slimed brick materials only; shared buildings textures and map geometry/collision are untouched.
validation: Source/pixel integrity, normal data, material references and generator remaps checked; native shader and material compilation passed. A headless Blender repeated-material preview was inspected; live gameplay was not exercised.
shader_validation: Native s&box vertex/forward/depth shader compilation passed; compiled shader is included.
material_import: All four materials compiled successfully through the native s&box resource compiler in a standalone command-line tool.
